app.name: VenuBoard
app.tagline: Modular websites and management for venues

shell.scaffoldNotice: Foundation only — product modules are not implemented yet

home.title: Application scaffold
home.description: This is the VenuBoard application shell. Routing, layout, internationalisation, environment handling, authentication and invitation acceptance are in place. Product modules are not implemented.
home.surfacesDescription: The three documented surfaces exist as labelled routes. Venue administration and platform administration require a signed-in identity with the right membership or platform role.
home.nextStep: Feed, staff, events, bookings, offers and atmosphere remain later work. Review the repository documentation before adding a module.

publicVenue.title: Public venue site
publicVenue.notImplemented: Tenant lookup is not implemented. This page shows the slug taken from the URL and nothing more: no venue record is loaded, no modules are resolved, and no entitlement or publication state is checked.
publicVenue.routingNote: Production will resolve a venue from its verified custom domain first, then its VenuBoard subdomain, and keep this path as a permanent fallback.

admin.title: Venue administration
admin.notImplemented: You are signed in with an applicable membership. Module navigation, entitlements and the venue switcher are not implemented yet.
admin.scopeNote: Once built, this surface will only show modules that are both entitled by the platform and enabled by the venue.

platform.title: VenuBoard platform administration
platform.notImplemented: You hold a platform role. Tenant creation, support sessions and MFA enrolment are not implemented. MFA is represented on the account but not enforced yet (OQ-40).
platform.scopeNote: Platform roles live separately from venue memberships and are never granted by tenant users.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This address does not match a route in the scaffold.

auth.signInDescription: Use your email and password, or request a magic link. New accounts are created only from an invitation.
auth.forgotDescription: If an account exists for that address, we will send a reset link. We do not confirm whether the address is registered.
auth.resetRequested: If an account exists for that address, a reset link has been sent.
auth.magicLinkSent: If an account exists for that address, a sign-in link has been sent.
auth.updatePasswordDescription: Choose a new password for this account.
auth.genericError: Something went wrong. Check your details and try again.
auth.validationFailed: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait and try again.
auth.unavailable: Sign-in is not available right now.

invite.title: Accept your invitation
invite.description: You were invited as {role} at {venue}. Sign in or set a password for {email}.
invite.invalidBody: This invitation link is not valid.
invite.expiredBody: This invitation has expired. Ask the venue to send a new one.
invite.revokedBody: This invitation is no longer active.
invite.acceptedBody: This invitation has already been accepted.
invite.emailMismatch: This invitation is for a different email address than the one you are signed in with.
invite.membershipConflict: You already have a different role in this venue.
invite.needSignIn: Sign in to accept this invitation.

unauthorized.title: Access denied
unauthorized.description: You are signed in, but you do not have access to this part of VenuBoard.
